name: PRANTE Translator Tools
description: Deterministic translation-analysis tools for PRANTE: segmentation, repeats, glossary, TM, memory candidates, comparison, QA, and exportable translation files.

stateDir.description: Optional local state directory. Defaults to OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/prante-translator-tools or ~/.openclaw-prante/state/prante-translator-tools.

exportDir.description: Optional output directory for exported translation files. Defaults to the PRANTE workspace exports directory.
